export default "---\ntitle: \"React服务端渲染与Next.js深度解析\"\nexcerpt: \"深入探讨React服务端渲染的原理、Next.js的核心特性以及最佳实践，帮助开发者构建高性能、SEO友好的React应用\"\ncoverImage: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\ndate: \"2025-10-30\"\nauthor:\n  name: 小羽\n  picture: \"/assets/blog/authors/jj.jpeg\"\nogImage:\n  url: \"/assets/blog/dynamic-routing/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# React服务端渲染与Next.js深度解析\n\n## 前言\n\n随着前端应用复杂度的增加，客户端渲染(CSR)面临首屏加载慢、SEO不友好等问题。服务端渲染(SSR)通过在服务器上生成初始HTML，有效解决了这些问题。Next.js作为React生态中最流行的SSR框架，提供了完整的解决方案。本文将深入探讨React服务端渲染的原理、Next.js的核心特性以及最佳实践，帮助你构建高性能、SEO友好的React应用。\n\n## 服务端渲染基础\n\n### 客户端渲染 vs 服务端渲染\n\n#### 客户端渲染(CSR)\n\n```jsx\n// 客户端渲染流程\n// 1. 服务器返回空HTML\n// 2. 浏览器下载JavaScript\n// 3. JavaScript执行，渲染页面\n\n// 传统React应用示例\nimport React from 'react'\nimport { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'\n\nfunction App() {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(null)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    fetch('/api/data')\n      .then(res => res.json())\n      .then(data => setData(data))\n  }, [])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>My App</h1>\n      {data ? <div>{data.content}</div> : <div>Loading...</div>}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 客户端渲染的HTML输出\n// <!DOCTYPE html>\n// <html>\n//   <head>\n//     <title>My App</title>\n//     <script src=\"bundle.js\"></script>\n//   </head>\n//   <body>\n//     <div id=\"root\"></div>\n//   </body>\n// </html>\n```\n\n#### 服务端渲染(SSR)\n\n```jsx\n// 服务端渲染流程\n// 1. 服务器执行React代码，生成HTML\n// 2. 服务器返回完整HTML\n// 3. 浏览器显示内容，同时下载JavaScript\n// 4. JavaScript执行，添加交互功能\n\n// 服务端渲染示例\nimport express from 'express'\nimport React from 'react'\nimport { renderToString } from 'react-dom/server'\nimport App from './App'\n\nconst app = express()\n\napp.get('/', (req, res) => {\n  // 在服务器上获取数据\n  return fetch('http://api.example.com/data')\n    .then(res => res.json())\n    .then(data => {\n      // 渲染React组件为HTML字符串\n      const html = renderToString(<App data={data} />)\n      \n      // 发送完整HTML\n      res.send(`\n        <!DOCTYPE html>\n        <html>\n          <head>\n            <title>My App</title>\n          </head>\n          <body>\n            <div id=\"root\">${html}</div>\n            <script>\n              window.__INITIAL_DATA__ = ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n            </script>\n            <script src=\"bundle.js\"></script>\n          </body>\n        </html>\n      `)\n    })\n})\n\napp.listen(3000)\n\n// 客户端hydration\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { hydrateRoot } from 'react-dom/client'\n\nfunction App({ data: initialData }) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(initialData)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 如果没有初始数据，从API获取\n    if (!data) {\n      fetch('/api/data')\n        .then(res => res.json())\n        .then(data => setData(data))\n    }\n  }, [data])\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>My App</h1>\n      {data ? <div>{data.content}</div> : <div>Loading...</div>}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 获取服务器传递的初始数据\nconst initialData = window.__INITIAL_DATA__\n\n// Hydration使服务器渲染的HTML具有交互性\nhydrateRoot(\n  document.getElementById('root'),\n  <App data={initialData} />\n)\n```\n\n### SSR的优势与挑战\n\n#### 优势\n\n1. **更快的首屏加载**：服务器返回完整HTML，浏览器可以立即显示内容\n2. **更好的SEO**：搜索引擎可以直接抓取页面内容\n3. **更好的性能**：减少客户端JavaScript执行时间\n4. **更好的用户体验**：减少白屏时间\n\n#### 挑战\n\n1. **服务器负载增加**：每个请求都需要在服务器上渲染React组件\n2. **开发复杂性**：需要处理服务器和客户端环境差异\n3. **状态管理**：需要在服务器和客户端之间同步状态\n4. **生命周期差异**：某些生命周期只在客户端执行\n\n## Next.js基础\n\n### Next.js简介\n\nNext.js是一个基于React的全栈框架，提供了：\n\n- 服务端渲染(SSR)\n- 静态站点生成(SSG)\n- API路由\n- 自动代码分割\n- 图片优化\n- 内置CSS支持\n- TypeScript支持\n\n### 创建Next.js应用\n\n```bash\n# 创建Next.js应用\nnpx create-next-app@latest my-app\n\n# 或使用TypeScript模板\nnpx create-next-app@latest my-app --typescript\n\n# 项目结构\nmy-app/\n├── pages/              # 页面组件\n│   ├── _app.tsx       # App组件\n│   ├── _document.tsx  # Document组件\n│   └── index.tsx      # 首页\n├── public/            # 静态资源\n├── styles/            # 样式文件\n└── package.json\n```\n\n### 基本页面组件\n\n```tsx\n// pages/index.tsx\nimport { GetServerSideProps } from 'next'\nimport { NextPage } from 'next'\nimport Head from 'next/head'\n\ntype HomeProps = {\n  data: {\n    title: string\n    content: string\n  }\n}\n\nconst Home: NextPage<HomeProps> = ({ data }) => {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Head>\n        <title>{data.title}</title>\n        <meta name=\"description\" content={data.content} />\n      </Head>\n      \n      <main>\n        <h1>{data.title}</h1>\n        <p>{data.content}</p>\n      </main>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 服务端渲染数据获取\nexport const getServerSideProps: GetServerSideProps<HomeProps> = async (context) => {\n  // 从API获取数据\n  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')\n  const data = await res.json()\n  \n  // 返回props给页面组件\n  return {\n    props: {\n      data\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport default Home\n```\n\n## Next.js数据获取方法\n\n### getServerSideProps (SSR)\n\n在每次请求时在服务器上运行：\n\n```tsx\n// pages/posts/[id].tsx\nimport { GetServerSideProps } from 'next'\nimport { NextPage } from 'next'\n\ntype PostProps = {\n  post: {\n    id: number\n    title: string\n    content: string\n    author: string\n  }\n}\n\nconst Post: NextPage<PostProps> = ({ post }) => {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{post.title}</h1>\n      <p>By {post.author}</p>\n      <div>{post.content}</div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport const getServerSideProps: GetServerSideProps<PostProps> = async (context) => {\n  const { id } = context.params\n  \n  // 从API获取数据\n  const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${id}`)\n  const post = await res.json()\n  \n  // 如果文章不存在，返回404\n  if (!post) {\n    return {\n      notFound: true\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      post\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport default Post\n```\n\n### getStaticProps (SSG)\n\n在构建时运行，生成静态HTML：\n\n```tsx\n// pages/about.tsx\nimport { GetStaticProps } from 'next'\nimport { NextPage } from 'next'\n\ntype AboutProps = {\n  companyInfo: {\n    name: string\n    description: string\n    founded: number\n  }\n}\n\nconst About: NextPage<AboutProps> = ({ companyInfo }) => {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>About {companyInfo.name}</h1>\n      <p>{companyInfo.description}</p>\n      <p>Founded in {companyInfo.founded}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport const getStaticProps: GetStaticProps<AboutProps> = async () => {\n  // 在构建时获取数据\n  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/company')\n  const companyInfo = await res.json()\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      companyInfo\n    },\n    // 重新生成页面的时间（秒）\n    revalidate: 60 // 60秒后重新生成\n  }\n}\n\nexport default About\n```\n\n### getStaticPaths\n\n为动态路由指定静态生成的路径：\n\n```tsx\n// pages/posts/[id].tsx\nimport { GetStaticPaths, GetStaticProps } from 'next'\nimport { NextPage } from 'next'\n\ntype PostProps = {\n  post: {\n    id: number\n    title: string\n    content: string\n  }\n}\n\nconst Post: NextPage<PostProps> = ({ post }) => {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{post.title}</h1>\n      <div>{post.content}</div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 指定哪些路径需要静态生成\nexport const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () => {\n  // 获取所有文章ID\n  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/posts')\n  const posts = await res.json()\n  \n  // 生成路径\n  const paths = posts.map((post: { id: number }) => ({\n    params: { id: post.id.toString() }\n  }))\n  \n  return {\n    paths,\n    fallback: 'blocking' // 'blocking' | true | false\n  }\n}\n\nexport const getStaticProps: GetStaticProps<PostProps> = async ({ params }) => {\n  const { id } = params\n  \n  // 获取特定文章数据\n  const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${id}`)\n  const post = await res.json()\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      post\n    },\n    // 重新生成页面的时间\n    revalidate: 3600 // 1小时\n  }\n}\n\nexport default Post\n```\n\n### 客户端数据获取\n\n使用SWR或React Query在客户端获取数据：\n\n```tsx\n// pages/profile.tsx\nimport useSWR from 'swr'\n\n// fetcher函数\nconst fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then(res => res.json())\n\nfunction Profile() {\n  // 使用SWR获取数据\n  const { data, error, isLoading } = useSWR('/api/user', fetcher)\n  \n  if (error) return <div>Failed to load</div>\n  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{data.name}</h1>\n      <p>Email: {data.email}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default Profile\n\n// 使用React Query\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\n\nfunction ProfileWithReactQuery() {\n  const { data, error, isLoading } = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['user'],\n    queryFn: () => fetch('/api/user').then(res => res.json())\n  })\n  \n  if (error) return <div>Failed to load</div>\n  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{data.name}</h1>\n      <p>Email: {data.email}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js路由系统\n\n### 基本路由\n\n```tsx\n// pages/index.tsx - 首页 (/)\nexport default function HomePage() {\n  return <h1>Home Page</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/about.tsx - 关于页面 (/about)\nexport default function AboutPage() {\n  return <h1>About Page</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/blog/index.tsx - 博客列表页 (/blog)\nexport default function BlogListPage() {\n  return <h1>Blog List</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/blog/[slug].tsx - 动态博客页面 (/blog/my-first-post)\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function BlogPostPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { slug } = router.query\n  \n  return <h1>Blog Post: {slug}</h1>\n}\n```\n\n### 动态路由与捕获所有路由\n\n```tsx\n// pages/docs/[...slug].tsx - 捕获所有路由 (/docs/getting-started/installation)\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function DocPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { slug } = router.query // slug = ['getting-started', 'installation']\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Documentation</h1>\n      <p>Path: {slug?.join('/')}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// pages/shop/[category]/[item].tsx - 多级动态路由\nexport default function ShopItemPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { category, item } = router.query\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{item}</h1>\n      <p>Category: {category}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### 路由导航\n\n```tsx\n// 使用Link组件进行客户端导航\nimport Link from 'next/link'\n\nfunction Navigation() {\n  return (\n    <nav>\n      <Link href=\"/\">\n        <a>Home</a>\n      </Link>\n      <Link href=\"/about\">\n        <a>About</a>\n      </Link>\n      <Link href=\"/blog/my-first-post\">\n        <a>Blog Post</a>\n      </Link>\n      \n      {/* 动态路由 */}\n      <Link href={`/docs/${docPath}`}>\n        <a>Documentation</a>\n      </Link>\n    </nav>\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用useRouter进行程序化导航\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nfunction LoginForm() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {\n    event.preventDefault()\n    \n    // 登录逻辑...\n    \n    // 登录成功后重定向\n    router.push('/dashboard')\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n      {/* 表单字段 */}\n      <button type=\"submit\">Login</button>\n    </form>\n  )\n}\n\n// 路由参数\nfunction PostPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { id } = router.query\n  \n  return <div>Post ID: {id}</div>\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js API路由\n\n### 基本API路由\n\n```ts\n// pages/api/hello.ts - API路由 (/api/hello)\nimport type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from 'next'\n\ntype ResponseData = {\n  message: string\n  timestamp: string\n}\n\nexport default function handler(\n  req: NextApiRequest,\n  res: NextApiResponse<ResponseData>\n) {\n  // 处理不同的HTTP方法\n  switch (req.method) {\n    case 'GET':\n      // GET请求处理\n      res.status(200).json({\n        message: 'Hello from Next.js API!',\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      break\n      \n    case 'POST':\n      // POST请求处理\n      const { name } = req.body\n      \n      if (!name) {\n        return res.status(400).json({ \n          message: 'Name is required',\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n        })\n      }\n      \n      res.status(201).json({\n        message: `Hello, ${name}!`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      break\n      \n    default:\n      // 不支持的方法\n      res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'POST'])\n      res.status(405).json({\n        message: `Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 动态API路由\n\n```ts\n// pages/api/users/[id].ts - 动态API路由 (/api/users/123)\nimport type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from 'next'\n\nexport default async function handler(\n  req: NextApiRequest,\n  res: NextApiResponse\n) {\n  const { id } = req.query\n  \n  // 根据HTTP方法处理请求\n  switch (req.method) {\n    case 'GET':\n      // 获取用户信息\n      try {\n        const user = await getUserById(id as string)\n        \n        if (!user) {\n          return res.status(404).json({ message: 'User not found' })\n        }\n        \n        res.status(200).json(user)\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    case 'PUT':\n      // 更新用户信息\n      try {\n        const updatedUser = await updateUser(id as string, req.body)\n        res.status(200).json(updatedUser)\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    case 'DELETE':\n      // 删除用户\n      try {\n        await deleteUser(id as string)\n        res.status(204).end()\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    default:\n      res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'PUT', 'DELETE'])\n      res.status(405).json({ message: `Method ${req.method} Not Allowed` })\n  }\n}\n\n// 模拟数据库操作\nasync function getUserById(id: string) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会查询数据库\n  return { id, name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' }\n}\n\nasync function updateUser(id: string, data: any) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会更新数据库\n  return { id, ...data }\n}\n\nasync function deleteUser(id: string) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会从数据库删除用户\n  return true\n}\n```\n\n### 中间件\n\n```ts\n// middleware.ts - 全局中间件\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'\n\nexport function middleware(request: NextRequest) {\n  // 获取请求路径\n  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname\n  \n  // 检查认证状态\n  const token = request.cookies.get('auth_token')?.value\n  \n  // 保护需要认证的路由\n  if (path.startsWith('/dashboard') && !token) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))\n  }\n  \n  // 添加自定义头\n  const response = NextResponse.next()\n  response.headers.set('x-custom-header', 'custom-value')\n  \n  return response\n}\n\n// 配置中间件匹配的路径\nexport const config = {\n  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*', '/api/protected/:path*']\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js样式与优化\n\n### CSS模块\n\n```tsx\n// components/Button.module.css\n.button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  border-radius: 5px;\n  font-weight: bold;\n  transition: background-color 0.2s;\n}\n\n.primary {\n  background-color: blue;\n  color: white;\n}\n\n.primary:hover {\n  background-color: darkblue;\n}\n\n.secondary {\n  background-color: gray;\n  color: white;\n}\n\n// components/Button.tsx\nimport styles from './Button.module.css'\n\ntype ButtonProps = {\n  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary'\n  children: React.ReactNode\n  onClick?: () => void\n}\n\nexport default function Button({ variant = 'primary', children, onClick }: ButtonProps) {\n  return (\n    <button \n      className={`${styles.button} ${styles[variant]}`}\n      onClick={onClick}\n    >\n      {children}\n    </button>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### 全局样式\n\n```css\n// styles/globals.css\n/* 全局样式 */\nhtml,\nbody {\n  padding: 0;\n  margin: 0;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen,\n    Ubuntu, Cantarell, Fira Sans, Droid Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif;\n}\n\na {\n  color: inherit;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n\n/* 响应式设计 */\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  html {\n    color-scheme: dark;\n  }\n  body {\n    color: white;\n    background: black;\n  }\n}\n\n// pages/_app.tsx - 导入全局样式\nimport '../styles/globals.css'\nimport type { AppProps } from 'next/app'\n\nexport default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {\n  return <Component {...pageProps} />\n}\n```\n\n### 图片优化\n\n```tsx\n// components/OptimizedImage.tsx\nimport Image from 'next/image'\n\ntype OptimizedImageProps = {\n  src: string\n  alt: string\n  width: number\n  height: number\n  priority?: boolean\n}\n\nexport default function OptimizedImage({ \n  src, \n  alt, \n  width, \n  height, \n  priority = false \n}: OptimizedImageProps) {\n  return (\n    <Image\n      src={src}\n      alt={alt}\n      width={width}\n      height={height}\n      priority={priority} // 优先加载重要图片\n      placeholder=\"blur\" // 加载时显示模糊占位符\n      blurDataURL=\"data:image/jpeg;base64,\"\n    />\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用示例\nfunction ProductCard({ product }) {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <OptimizedImage\n        src={product.image}\n        alt={product.name}\n        width={300}\n        height={200}\n        priority={product.featured}\n      />\n      <h3>{product.name}</h3>\n      <p>{product.price}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js部署与优化\n\n### 构建优化\n\n```json\n// next.config.js\n/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */\nconst nextConfig = {\n  // 启用实验性功能\n  experimental: {\n    // 启用App Router (Next.js 13+)\n    appDir: true,\n    // 优化服务器组件\n    serverComponentsExternalPackages: ['some-package']\n  },\n  \n  // 图片优化配置\n  images: {\n    domains: ['example.com', 'cdn.example.com'],\n    formats: ['image/webp', 'image/avif'],\n    deviceSizes: [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920, 2048, 3840],\n    imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384]\n  },\n  \n  // 压缩配置\n  compress: true,\n  \n  // PWA配置\n  pwa: {\n    dest: 'public',\n    disable: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'\n  },\n  \n  // 环境变量\n  env: {\n    CUSTOM_KEY: process.env.CUSTOM_KEY\n  },\n  \n  // 重定向\n  async redirects() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/old-path',\n        destination: '/new-path',\n        permanent: true\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // 重写\n  async rewrites() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/api/blog/:path*',\n        destination: 'https://external-api.com/blog/:path*'\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // 头部配置\n  async headers() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/api/:path*',\n        headers: [\n          { key: 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin', value: '*' },\n          { key: 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods', value: 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT' }\n        ]\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // Webpack配置\n  webpack: (config, { buildId, dev, isServer, defaultLoaders, webpack }) => {\n    // 自定义Webpack配置\n    return config\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = nextConfig\n```\n\n### 性能监控\n\n```tsx\n// components/PerformanceMonitor.tsx\nimport { useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function PerformanceMonitor() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 监控路由变化\n    const handleRouteChange = (url: string) => {\n      // 记录页面访问\n      if (window.gtag) {\n        window.gtag('config', 'GA_MEASUREMENT_ID', {\n          page_path: url,\n        })\n      }\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      if (window.performance) {\n        const navigation = window.performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming\n        const loadTime = navigation.loadEventEnd - navigation.fetchStart\n        \n        // 发送性能数据\n        if (window.gtag) {\n          window.gtag('event', 'page_load_time', {\n            value: Math.round(loadTime),\n            custom_map: { custom_parameter_1: 'page_load_time' }\n          })\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    router.events.on('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChange)\n    \n    return () => {\n      router.events.off('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChange)\n    }\n  }, [router.events])\n  \n  return null\n}\n\n// pages/_app.tsx - 使用性能监控\nimport '../styles/globals.css'\nimport type { AppProps } from 'next/app'\nimport PerformanceMonitor from '../components/PerformanceMonitor'\n\nexport default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <PerformanceMonitor />\n      <Component {...pageProps} />\n    </>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 实际应用案例\n\n### 电商网站\n\n```tsx\n// pages/products/[slug].tsx - 产品详情页\nimport { GetStaticProps, GetStaticPaths } from 'next'\nimport { GetProductBySlug, GetAllProductSlugs } from '../../lib/products'\nimport Image from 'next/image'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\nimport { useCart } from '../../context/CartContext'\n\ntype ProductProps = {\n  product: {\n    id: string\n    slug: string\n    name: string\n    description: string\n    price: number\n    images: string[]\n    inStock: boolean\n  }\n}\n\nexport default function ProductPage({ product }: ProductProps) {\n  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState(0)\n  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)\n  const { addToCart } = useCart()\n  \n  const handleAddToCart = () => {\n    addToCart({\n      id: product.id,\n      name: product.name,\n      price: product.price,\n      quantity\n    })\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div className=\"product-page\">\n      <div className=\"product-images\">\n        <div className=\"main-image\">\n          <Image\n            src={product.images[selectedImage]}\n            alt={product.name}\n            width={600}\n            height={600}\n            priority\n          />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"image-thumbnails\">\n          {product.images.map((image, index) => (\n            <button\n              key={index}\n              className={index === selectedImage ? 'active' : ''}\n              onClick={() => setSelectedImage(index)}\n            >\n              <Image\n                src={image}\n                alt={`${product.name} ${index + 1}`}\n                width={100}\n                height={100}\n              />\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      \n      <div className=\"product-info\">\n        <h1>{product.name}</h1>\n        <p className=\"price\">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>\n        <p className=\"description\">{product.description}</p>\n        \n        {product.inStock ? (\n          <div className=\"purchase-options\">\n            <div className=\"quantity-selector\">\n              <label>Quantity:</label>\n              <select \n                value={quantity} \n                onChange={(e) => setQuantity(Number(e.target.value))}\n              >\n                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(num => (\n                  <option key={num} value={num}>{num}</option>\n                ))}\n              </select>\n            </div>\n            \n            <button \n              className=\"add-to-cart-btn\"\n              onClick={handleAddToCart}\n            >\n              Add to Cart\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <p className=\"out-of-stock\">Out of Stock</p>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 静态生成所有产品页面\nexport async function getStaticPaths() {\n  const slugs = await GetAllProductSlugs()\n  \n  const paths = slugs.map(slug => ({\n    params: { slug }\n  }))\n  \n  return {\n    paths,\n    fallback: 'blocking' // 新产品可以按需生成\n  }\n}\n\n// 获取产品数据\nexport async function getStaticProps({ params }) {\n  const product = await GetProductBySlug(params.slug)\n  \n  if (!product) {\n    return { notFound: true }\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      product\n    },\n    revalidate: 3600 // 每小时重新生成\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 博客系统\n\n```tsx\n// pages/blog/index.tsx - 博客列表页\nimport { GetStaticProps } from 'next'\nimport { GetAllPosts, GetPaginatedPosts } from '../../lib/posts'\nimport Link from 'next/link'\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\ntype BlogProps = {\n  initialPosts: {\n    id: string\n    title: string\n    excerpt: string\n    publishedAt: string\n    slug: string\n  }[]\n  totalPages: number\n}\n\nexport default function Blog({ initialPosts, totalPages }: BlogProps) {\n  const [posts, setPosts] = useState(initialPosts)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  // 加载更多文章\n  const loadMorePosts = async () => {\n    setLoading(true)\n    const nextPage = page + 1\n    \n    try {\n      const newPosts = await GetPaginatedPosts(nextPage)\n      setPosts([...posts, ...newPosts])\n      setPage(nextPage)\n      \n      // 更新URL但不刷新页面\n      router.push(`/blog?page=${nextPage}`, undefined, { shallow: true })\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading more posts:', error)\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div className=\"blog-container\">\n      <h1>Blog</h1>\n      \n      <div className=\"posts-grid\">\n        {posts.map(post => (\n          <div key={post.id} className=\"post-card\">\n            <Link href={`/blog/${post.slug}`}>\n              <a>\n                <h2>{post.title}</h2>\n                <p>{post.excerpt}</p>\n                <time>{new Date(post.publishedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</time>\n              </a>\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n      \n      {page < totalPages && (\n        <div className=\"load-more-container\">\n          <button \n            onClick={loadMorePosts} \n            disabled={loading}\n            className=\"load-more-btn\"\n          >\n            {loading ? 'Loading...' : 'Load More Posts'}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 获取初始博客文章\nexport async function getStaticProps() {\n  const posts = await GetPaginatedPosts(1)\n  const totalPages = Math.ceil(await GetAllPosts().length / 6) // 每页6篇文章\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      initialPosts: posts,\n      totalPages\n    },\n    revalidate: 3600 // 每小时重新生成\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 总结\n\nNext.js为React应用提供了强大的服务端渲染能力，通过本文的介绍，我们了解了：\n\n1. **SSR与SSG的区别**：SSR在请求时渲染，SSG在构建时渲染\n2. **数据获取方法**：getServerSideProps、getStaticProps和getStaticPaths\n3. **路由系统**：基本路由、动态路由和捕获所有路由\n4. **API路由**：构建全栈应用的能力\n5. **样式与优化**：CSS模块、图片优化和构建配置\n6. **实际应用**：电商网站和博客系统的实现\n\nNext.js的选择取决于你的应用需求：\n\n- **内容驱动网站**：使用SSG获得最佳性能\n- **个性化内容**：使用SSR提供动态内容\n- **混合应用**：结合SSR和SSG，根据页面特性选择合适的渲染方式\n\n通过Next.js，你可以构建出高性能、SEO友好且用户体验优秀的React应用。无论是博客、电商网站还是企业应用，Next.js都能提供合适的解决方案。"
